# Bundled third-party software

This presentation includes the following upstream browser bundles. Their original code and copyright headers are preserved; the presentation's integration code lives separately in `runtime/`.

| Files | Upstream release | License |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `hyperframes-player.global.js`, `hyperframes-slideshow.global.js` | Official HyperFrames CLI 0.8.181 | Apache License 2.0; see `LICENSE-HYPERFRAMES.txt` |
| `gsap.min.js` | GSAP 3.14.2 | Standard "No Charge" GSAP License; see `LICENSE-GSAP.txt` |

HyperFrames source: <https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes>. The Apache license copy was retrieved from <https://raw.githubusercontent.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/main/LICENSE> on November 4, 2026.

GSAP source and terms: <https://gsap.com/> and <https://gsap.com/standard-license/>. The GSAP license copy includes the upstream terms and accompanying FAQ retrieved on November 4, 2026. That page lists an effective date of April 30, 2025 and a last-modified date of May 30, 2025. The bundle preserves its original GreenSock copyright notice and author credit to Jack Doyle. GSAP is distributed under its own license; the HyperFrames Apache license does not replace those terms.
